text:
I know of a book being written about this right now. We are destroying real people for crimes that do not happen against people who do not exist and when that imaginary person invites a person to meet.
It is evil, insane, and it is wrong. It is a wicked scheme that the bible specifically warns us about. People are just assuming they would know what happens in a situation they created themselves. People setting up others from crimes against imaginary people will see hell.
There are some strange people with mental issues in the comment sections. You see them all the time ranting about pedophilia on articles that have nothing to do with that topic. They are as bad as the far left talking about diversity and equity all the time.
Extremes are never good for anyone.
